events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez, born March 14th, 1968. I've had a bad sore throat. Can you prescribe me some amoxicillin ?
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I’ve sent your question to the prescribing team, and your reference is Q N, one five five six. A clinician will answer, and your prescription record has not been changed.
Okay, then. Please pass it on to a doctor.
I’ve already passed it to the Cedar Clinic prescribing team. Your reference is Q N, one five five six.
